FILTER(isLiteral(?giatri)) ?p rdfs:label ?thuoctinh OPTIONAL{:KLPTCertificate :sourceCitation ?nguon;:sourceLink ?duongdan} } UNION { :KLPTCertificate ?l ?con . ?con ?p ?giatri .
